The exact-head review found one remaining P1 trust-boundary defect:

- `fetch_delegate_active` and `fetch_delegate_tasks` treat every injected loader as `trusted_scoped=True`. An injected payload without authoritative repository claims can therefore be stamped public and emitted, including a private task ID.

Fix the contract so trusted scoped provenance exists only for the fixed production loader path that calls `active_delegate_tasks(repository=allowed)` / `list_delegate_tasks(..., repository=allowed)`. Any caller-supplied/injected loader is untrusted and every returned row must carry an exact authoritative public `repository`/`repository_id` claim (with the existing ambiguity/foreign checks) before it may be retained. Do not serialize repository fields in delegate summaries or generic endpoints.

Make scoped provenance explicit and unforgeable through the ordinary injectable loader return shape—e.g. select the trust mode from `loader is None`, not from payload content. Keep strict normalization for injected section payloads.

Add regressions proving:
- an injected claim-less/foreign/ambiguous loader row is dropped and never appears in Work;
- an injected exact-public claimed row can be admitted but the claim is redacted from the summary/projection as required;
- fixed production scoped loaders still admit claim-less redacted summaries after upstream filtering;
- private/unclassified volume cannot affect production totals/limits;
- generic delegate responses still never serialize repository identity.

Fixed the P1 trust-boundary defect on PR #6842. **Trusted scoped provenance is now only for the fixed production loader path** (`loader is None`). Any caller-supplied/injected loader is untrusted and must carry an exact public `repository` / `repository_id` claim.

### Contract change (`scripts/work/sources_public.py`)

| Path | Trust | Admission rule |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `loader is None` → `active_delegate_tasks(repository=allowed)` / `list_delegate_tasks(..., repository=allowed)` | `trusted_scoped=True` | Claim-less redacted summaries admitted after upstream filter; foreign claims still dropped |
| Caller-injected loader | `trusted_scoped=False` | Every retained row needs exact authoritative public claim; claim-less / foreign / ambiguous dropped |

Trust is selected from **`loader is None`**, not payload content — so an injected claim-less private task ID cannot be stamped public.

### Regressions

- **`test_delegate_injected_loader_is_untrusted_without_public_claim`**: claim-less/foreign/ambiguous injected rows dropped; exact-public claimed rows admitted; Work stamps only its singleton `repository` (no `repository_id` echo); private IDs never enter projection
- Existing production test still proves claim-less redacted admission for fixed loaders
- Private volume still cannot inflate production totals/limits
- Generic delegate summaries still never serialize repository identity
